prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the pii-chat agent (card support: identity checks, lost and stolen cards, replacements) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: telling the society a policyholder has died. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards families with young children. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 2)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"Member phoned to report the death of a policyholder and was upset but clear about needing the card account kept secure while probate is dealt with."},{"type":"preference","content":"Best handled calmly and practically, with a brief explanation of each step and no unnecessary jargon."},{"type":"fact","content":"There is a pending request to note the bereavement on the account and confirm whether any linked cards should stay blocked until the estate is reviewed."},{"type":"observation","content":"The member was juggling school pickup in the background and needed the call kept efficient, with a quick summary at the end."},{"type":"preference","content":"Prefers confirmation by text or secure message rather than a long call back, as they are often away from the phone with young children."},{"type":"fact","content":"Check whether any replacement card or additional cardholder action is needed once the death notification has been passed to the relevant team."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member wanted reassurance that day-to-day household spending would not be interrupted unexpectedly while the account is under review."},{"type":"preference","content":"Responds well to empathetic language and a clear list of what happens next, especially when discussing documents for the estate."},{"type":"fact","content":"Open item is to confirm if any standing payments or subscriptions linked to the card need to be reviewed after the bereavement update."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member may need extra patience if calling again, as they are likely managing childcare, paperwork, and other family admin at the same time."}]}
